docs.title: Welcome to MealPlan
docs.text: MealPlan is a smart meal preparation, macro tracking, and recipe scaling platform designed to help you achieve your exact dietary goals without the hassle of manual math.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• 🎯 Precision Macro Balancing: Scale recipe ingredients automatically using our mathematical solver.
  • 🗓️ Meal Prep Planning: Schedule recipes into structured prep cycles, track cooking progress, and scale batch yields.
  • 🛒 Consolidated Shopping Lists: Automatically aggregate ingredient amounts across multiple planned recipes into a single reorderable list.
  • 📦 Portion Storage Tracker: Keep exact counts of cooked meals stored in your fridge or freezer, complete with low-stock warnings.
  • 🧑‍🍳 AI Recipe Generation: Generate tailored recipes from simple text prompts matching your personal dietary goals.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Create an Account and verify your email address.
  2. Configure Your Nutrition Goals in Settings (daily calories, protein, carb, and fat splits).
  3. Build or Import Recipes to start meal prepping!

docs.title: Creating an Account
docs.text:
1. Click Get Started or Create Account on the welcome page.
  2. Enter a unique username (minimum 6 characters), valid email address, and secure password.
  3. Click Create Account.

docs.title: Email Verification
docs.text:
To ensure security and prevent unauthorized access, new users must verify their email address before logging in.

  1. After registering, check your email inbox for a verification email from MealPlan.
  2. Click the Verify Email link in the message.
  3. Once confirmed, you will be directed to the login page to sign in.

Didn't receive a verification link?

If you attempt to log in before verifying, a prompt will appear on the login screen allowing you to request a fresh verification link.

docs.title: Changing Your Email Address
docs.text:
1. Go to Settings ⚙️ from the navigation menu.
  2. Click ✏️ Change Email next to your current email address.
  3. Enter your new email address in the modal and click Send Verification Link.
  4. Check your new inbox and click the verification link to confirm the change.

docs.title: Account Deletion
docs.text:
1. Go to Settings ⚙️.
  2. Scroll down to the Danger Zone card.
  3. Click 🗑️ Delete Account and confirm the prompt.
  4. All personal data, meal plans, shopping lists, and portion storage records will be permanently removed.

docs.title: Nutrition Goals & Settings
docs.text: MealPlan uses your personal nutritional goals to calculate macro targets for every recipe you view, balance, or generate.

docs.title: Setting Daily Macronutrient Targets
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Settings ⚙️.
  2. Under Daily Nutrition Goals, enter your target daily grams for:
  3. Protein (g) (4 kcal/g)
  4. Net Carbs (g) (4 kcal/g)
  5. Fat (g) (9 kcal/g)
  6. Total calories and energy percentage distributions calculate automatically in real time.

docs.title: Configuring Meal Structure & Splits
docs.text:
• Number of Meals & Snacks: Choose how many meals (1–6) and snacks (0–6) you consume daily.
  • Macro Split Sliders: Adjust the percentage sliders to divide your daily macronutrients between meals and snacks (e.g., 80% for meals / 20% for snacks).
  • Calculated Per-Meal Target: MealPlan automatically computes the target macros for an individual meal or snack.

docs.title: Dietary Restrictions & Preferences
docs.text:
• Dietary Restrictions: Check applicable tags (Keto, Low-Carb, Vegan, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Nut-Free, Kosher, Halal, etc.).
  • Disliked Foods: Enter comma-separated ingredients or cuisines you want to avoid. The AI Recipe Generator and Macro Balancer will avoid recommending these items.

docs.title: Meal Prep Plans
docs.text: Plan and track weekly cooking cycles for your selected recipes.

docs.title: Creating a Meal Plan
docs.text:
1. Go to Meal Prep Planner 🗓️.
  2. Click + Create New Plan.
  3. Select the recipes you plan to cook and set the number of planned portions (scales in batches matching recipe yield).
  4. Check Set as my Active Plan and click Save Plan.

docs.title: Tracking Cooking Progress
docs.text:
• In your Active Plan, click ✔️ Mark Cooked when you prepare a recipe.
  • You can optionally log the prepared portions directly into your Portion Storage tracker.

docs.title: Shopping List
docs.text: Generate and manage consolidated grocery lists for your meal prep plans.

docs.title: Appending Plans to Shopping List
docs.text:
1. Open your Shopping List 🛒 and make sure that you have only items that you want to get unchecked.
  2. Open Meal Prep Planner 🗓️
  3. Click 🛒 Add to Shopping List on any meal plan.
  4. Ingredients across all planned recipes are consolidated into single line items, and added to your shopping list. (If any ingredients use different measures, then they will be listed twice in the shopping list.)

docs.title: List Features
docs.text:
• Automatic Consolidation: Identical ingredients are combined by unit and weight.
  • Drag-and-Drop Reordering: Drag items to reorder your shopping sequence.
  • Custom Items: Quickly add custom non-recipe items (e.g., paper towels, zip bags).
  • Checking Off Items: Check off items as you shop; checked items move to the bottom section.

docs.title: Portion Storage & Fridge Tracking
docs.text: Track prepared recipe portions stored in your fridge or freezer.

docs.title: Adding Portions to Storage
docs.text:
• From Meal Plans: Mark a planned recipe as cooked and log the prepared portions.
  • From Recipe Details: Open any recipe and click 📦 Add to Storage.

docs.title: Recording Consumption
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Portion Storage 📦.
  2. Click 🍴 Record Eating 1 Portion on a stored recipe card to deduct a portion.

docs.title: Low-Stock Warnings
docs.text: Recipes with 3 or fewer portions remaining display a yellow/red low-stock warning alert on your Home Dashboard so you know when it's time to prep again.

docs.title: AI Recipe Generator
docs.text: Generate complete, balanced, USDA-verified recipes from simple natural language text descriptions.

docs.title: Generating a Recipe
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Recipes 🍳 and click 🧑‍🍳 Generate with AI.
  2. Enter a description of your recipe idea (e.g., "Creamy garlic chicken bowl with asparagus and brown rice").
  3. Select category (Meal or Snack).
  4. Toggle Target My User Settings Macros to automatically align the recipe yield to your target macro splits. (or choose not to provide targets to give the AI more creative freedom)
  5. Select any dietary restrictions and click Generate Recipe.

docs.title: Ingredient Verification Waterfall
docs.text:
Every ingredient generated by AI passes through a 3-stage resolution pipeline:

  1. Local DB Match: Matched against verified system ingredients.
  2. USDA API Lookup: Looked up via USDA FoodData Central and saved globally if macros are found.
  3. AI Fallback Estimation: Estimated safely using AI generated nutrition information if absent from USDA.

docs.title: Community Recipe Discovery
docs.text: Explore, favorite, and copy recipes created by the community.

docs.title: Searching & Filtering
docs.text:
1. Click 🔍 Search Community in the Recipes view or Home page.
  2. Search by keyword or apply dietary filter tags (Keto, High-Protein, Dairy-Free, etc.).

docs.title: Favoriting & Copying (Forking)
docs.text:
• Favorite (★): Saves the recipe to your My Favorites collection.
  • Copy Recipe (📋): Clones the public recipe into your personal library, allowing you to edit ingredient weights, instructions, or scale portions for your own prep plans.

docs.title: Macro Balancer Engine
docs.text: The Macronutrient Balancer automatically scales ingredient weights in a recipe so that a single portion hits your exact nutritional targets.

docs.title: How It Works
docs.text:
1. In the Recipe Builder under the ingredients list, click ⚖️ Balance Macros.
  2. The system executes a mathematic solver to scale active ingredients while preserving flavor structure and seasonings.

docs.title: Solver States & Interventions
docs.text:
• Success: The recipe balances mathematically within a +/-10% tolerance band. You can review the new ingredient weights and save.
  • Action Required (Intervention): If math alone cannot balance the recipe (e.g. missing a primary carb source), the AI suggests culinary fixes:
  • ADD: Recommends adding a new macro-dense ingredient.
  • SWAP: Recommends replacing a conflicting ingredient.
  • REMOVE: Prompts removal of an ingredient that conflicts with a 0g target.
  • Approximate Match (Circuit Breaker): After 4 intervention attempts, the solver returns the closest mathematical approximation without altering the dish further. (You can save the results (or not), and edit the ingredients manually, then re-run the balancer to try again with a slightly different recipe.)

docs.title: Recipe Builder
docs.text: The Recipe Builder allows you to create custom recipes with real-time per-portion macronutrient calculations.

docs.title: Creating a Recipe
docs.text:
1. Go to Recipes 🍳 and click + Create Custom Recipe.
  2. Enter a Recipe Title, category (Meal or Snack), and access level (Public or Private).
  3. Set the number of Portions (recipe yield), preparation time, description, and step-by-step instructions.

docs.title: Adding Ingredients
docs.text:
1. Click + Add Ingredient to search the ingredient database.
  2. Select an ingredient from the search results or create a custom ingredient if needed.
  3. Enter the physical Weight (g) used in the recipe yield.
  4. Optionally enter human-readable display amounts (e.g., 2 tbsp or 1 cup).

Real-Time Macro Feedback

As you adjust ingredient weights or recipe yield portions, the top banner updates per-portion calories, protein, net carbs, and fat in real time, highlighting how close the recipe is to your personal target.

docs.title: Why is my login attempt rejected?
docs.text: MealPlan requires email verification. Check your inbox for a verification email and click the link to activate your account. You can request a fresh link directly from the login screen if needed.

docs.title: Why did the Macro Balancer suggest adding or removing an ingredient?
docs.text:
If a recipe is structurally missing a macro (e.g., a dish with chicken and oil has zero sources for carbohydrates), mathematical scaling alone cannot reach a carb target. The balancer suggests an ingredient addition (like brown rice) to make the recipe mathematically solvable while preserving culinary quality.

If you have a Zero Target (0g) for one of your macros (e.g. 0 carbs allocated to snack recipes), then any ingredient including that macro will be removed from the recipe during balancing.

docs.title: Why are low-stock warnings showing on my Home Dashboard?
docs.text: When a recipe in Portion Storage drops to 3 or fewer remaining portions, a low-stock alert appears on your Home page to remind you to schedule a new meal prep session.
